tagline: Discovery-first fanfiction search with prompt generation.
summary: A fanfiction discovery platform designed to search existing tagged stories against complex, nuanced criteria before offering to generate a prompt. Tags are hierarchical with conditional branching rather than flat, so a search can express a specific premise instead of a keyword. In progress: the data and admin layers are built, the discovery search is not yet wired up.
highlights: In progress. The data model, validation engine and two-tier admin system are built; the discovery search and prompt generation exist as services but are not yet wired to the app.
Hierarchical tags with conditional branching express a premise, rather than the flat keyword lists other platforms use.
Designed to search what already exists before generating anything, so a reader is not handed a prompt for a story that has already been written.
Built for Cloudflare Pages and Workers with a D1 database, KV caching and Durable Object rate limiting; a worker answers at pensive.vkrishna04.me but does not yet serve the app itself.
Content is intended to grow through admin-curated submission; a browser extension for submitting stories is drafted but not yet built or published.
